content: llama.cpp HIP build: HIPCXX=$(hipconfig -l)/clang HIP_PATH=$(hipconfig -R) cmake -S . -B build -DGGML_HIP=ON -DGPU_TARGETS=gfx1100 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release. GPU_TARGETS is current canonical flag; AMDGPU_TARGETS legacy alias forwarded to it. Optional -DGGML_HIP_ROCWMMA_FATTN=ON enables rocWMMA FA on RDNA3+ (needs rocWMMA headers); big PP gains reported on 7900 XTX but known prefill regressions on gfx1151 and compile issues on some ROCm versions - treat as A/B benchmark flag not default.
